title: PatTransBench: an ipc-stratified, multi-dimensional benchmark for patent machine translation evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation (PatMT) benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol. The benchmark comprises 6,000 short-text (sentence/claim) and 6,000 long-text (paragraph) pairs, evenly split across three language pairs and both translation directions, built via IPC-section-stratified sampling and dualthreshold quality gating from upstream patent-family parallel corpora. The evaluation protocol spans literal n-gram overlap (BLEU, ROUGE-L, chrF), cross-lingual semantic textual similarity (CLSTS), 38-probe-language consistency testing, and serving performance under concurrency. A case study on PatMT2-7B and its fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit variants reveals direction-dependent quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns across quantization schemes that are invisible to single-metric evaluation. translated_title: PatTransBench：一个用于专利机器翻译评估的IPC分层、多维度基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了PatTransBench，这是一个包含12,000条数据的中文-英/日/韩专利机器翻译基准测试，配有四维评估协议。该基准测试包含6,000对短文本（句子/权利要求）和6,000对长文本（段落），在三个语言对和两个翻译方向上均匀分布，通过IPC分类部分分层采样和双重阈值质量筛选从上游专利族平行语料库构建而成。评估协议涵盖字面n-gram重叠（BLEU、ROUGE-L、chrF）、跨语言语义文本相似度（CLSTS）、38种探测语言一致性测试，以及并发条件下的服务性能。对PatMT2-7B及其fp8/AWQ4/AutoRound-4bit变体的案例研究揭示了被聚合分数掩盖的与翻译方向相关的量化效应，以及单指标评估无法察觉的跨量化方案的非单调语言失败模式。我们计划发布……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了PatTransBench，一个包含12,000条数据的中文-英/日/韩专利机器翻译多维度评估基准，其四维评估协议能够揭示传统聚合分数掩盖的量化效应以及单指标评估无法发现的语言失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PatTransBench, a 12,000-item Chinese-English/Japanese/Korean patent machine translation benchmark with a four-dimensional evaluation protocol that reveals quantization effects masked by aggregate scores and non-monotonic language-failure patterns invisible to single-metric evaluation.
